title: Alpha Diffusion Language Models: Factorization Alone Is Not the Problem
abstract: arXiv:2609.38066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but reducing the number of denoising steps can lead to inconsistent predictions. Standard cross-entropy training fits conditional token marginals, whereas parallel generation requires consistent joint predictions. We introduce Alpha Diffusion Language Models (AlphaDLM), trained with a sequence-level alpha loss that recovers cross-entropy in the limit of vanishing alpha and has a joint-mode optimum at alpha one. Our analysis characterizes how the objective and factorization jointly determine the fitted distribution. We identify conditions under which intermediate alpha preserves multiple valid completions while excluding invalid token combinations. Trained on TinyGSM, our method achieves 34.6% accuracy on GSM8K with only four model evaluations. We further scale the method to SDAR-1.7B and evaluate it on code and mathematics benchmarks. translated_title: Alpha扩散语言模型：仅靠因式分解并不是问题的根源
translated_abstract: 离散扩散语言模型可以并行生成多个token，但减少去噪步骤的数量可能导致预测不一致。标准的交叉熵训练拟合的是条件token边缘分布，而并行生成需要一致的联合预测。我们提出了Alpha扩散语言模型（AlphaDLM），使用序列级alpha损失进行训练，该损失在alpha趋于零时恢复为交叉熵，并在alpha为1时具有联合模式最优。我们的分析刻画了目标函数与因式分解如何共同决定所拟合的分布。我们识别了在何种条件下，中间的alpha值能够保留多个有效的补全结果，同时排除无效的token组合。在TinyGSM上训练后，我们的方法仅用四次模型评估就在GSM8K上达到了34.6%的准确率。我们进一步将该方法扩展到SDAR-1.7B，并在代码和数学基准上进行了评估。这些结果表明…
tldr: 该论文提出Alpha扩散语言模型（AlphaDLM），通过序列级alpha损失解决离散扩散模型并行生成时的联合预测一致性问题，仅用四次模型评估就在GSM8K上达到34.6%的准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Alpha Diffusion Language Models (AlphaDLM), which use a sequence-level alpha loss to enable consistent joint predictions for parallel generation, achieving 34.6% accuracy on GSM8K with only four model evaluations.
